name: Coral des Abimes
description: Cité flottante sur les océans stellaires, Coral des Abimes cultive les récifs stellaires, maîtrise l'élément Eau. Son équipement pressurisé lui permet de naviguer dans les courants les plus dangereux, loin des contraintes des mondes arides.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy mineralogic mining exosuit: thick rust‑orange and gunmetal plating over a polymer pressure suit, spherical water‑filled helmet, massive hydraulic joints, exposed copper cooling coils, steam‑leaking valves
loadout.arsenal: Integrated thermal circular saw, plasma rotary cutter, high‑pressure geyser cannon, hydraulic tentacle manipulators

attitude.behavior: Floating weightlessly in microgravity, extending bioluminescent tentacles to graft living coral structures, adjusting pressure valves, emitting cyan glow
attitude.emotion: Serene focus, a calm yet intense dedication to building autonomous aquatic ecosystems in the void

palette_names.name: Deep Rust Orange
palette_names.role: primary armor tone, weathered and oxidized

palette_names.name: Verdigris Green
palette_names.role: copper patina on joints and piping

palette_names.name: Cyan Bioluminescent
palette_names.role: energy and water glow, shield effect, alien skin luminescence

palette_names.name: Thermal Orange Plasma
palette_names.role: weapon fire, steam vents, intense heat accent

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with cyan bioluminescent fill, harsh orange backlight on plasma, volumetric steam and water vapor, high‑contrast shadows
color_and_light.mood: Ominous, awe‑inspiring, industrial desperation with a glimmer of alien life

camera.angle: low angle, slight dutch tilt, looking up at the towering cephalopod architect

scenography.setting: Orbital abyssal platform: massive spherical water tanks and metallic scaffolding floating in deep space, coral‑like bio‑structures sprouting, exposed piping, steam vents, microgravity droplets suspended
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Floating water droplets, cyan bioluminescent glow, plasma sparks, steam plumes, micro‑meteorite scarring, faint aurora‑like energy fields, occasional steam bursts from valves
